1.

Now the day of grace is come, In faith go to the cross, For the best of works Cannot save thee, For the best of works Cannot save thee.

2.

In the Lord Jesus Christ, Who died on the cross here, Perfect salvation is found, His work is finished, Perfect salvation is found, His work is finished.

3.

And God looks upon Christ, His blood’s outpouring, For the sinner has brought forth A full forgiveness, For the sinner has brought forth A full forgiveness.

4.

And still Jesus says, What He has said before: Behold, him that cometh unto Me, I will in no wise cast out, Behold, him that cometh unto Me, I will in no wise cast out.

5.

For him who works not, But believes on Christ alone, God has prepared a salvation And bliss without measure, God has prepared a salvation And bliss without measure.
